description.value: Walmart Supercentre is a large-format big-box retailer in Salmon Arm offering a full grocery section alongside general merchandise including electronics, clothing, and baby goods. As one of the largest retail footprints in the area, it is a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the Shuswap region. The store carries a broad range of consumables that would appeal to cyclists stocking up for extended touring.
